en.headline: Observatory expects heavy early Saturday showers then mainly fine Sunday
en.dek: Saturday begins with heavy showers and possible squally thunderstorms before easing with sunny periods, while Sunday is forecast mainly fine with temperatures up to 28 degrees.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said upper-air disturbances would bring heavy showers and a few squally thunderstorms to the territory at first on Saturday before the system moves away and conditions improve during the day.

According to the latest nine-day forecast updated on Friday evening, Saturday will be mainly cloudy with a few showers that are expected to be heavy with squally thunderstorms early on, easing later with sunny periods in the afternoon. Temperatures will range from 23 to 27 degrees. Winds will be east to northeast force 3 to 4, force 5 offshore and occasionally up to force 7 on high ground at first.

Sunday is forecast to be mainly fine, becoming cloudy at night, with temperatures between 22 and 28 degrees. Light winds of force 2 are expected, becoming east force 3 to 4 later. The Observatory earlier issued a special weather tip advising the public to monitor updates and take care during outdoor activities as showers could increase overnight into Saturday morning.
No official weather warnings were in force as of early Saturday, but the forecast indicates a risk of squally thunderstorms early in the day on Saturday before improvement.

zh.headline: 天文台預料周六初時雨勢頗大周日大致天晴
zh.dek: 香港天文台預測周六初時有大驟雨及幾陣狂風雷暴，日間減弱下午有陽光；周日大致天晴，氣溫介乎22至28度。
body: 香港天文台表示，高空擾動會在周六初時為本港帶來大驟雨及幾陣狂風雷暴，其後隨著擾動遠離，日間天氣好轉。
根據周五晚上更新的最新九天天氣預報，周六大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，初時雨勢頗大並有幾陣狂風雷暴，日間驟雨減少，下午部分時間有陽光。氣溫介乎23至27度。吹東至東北風3至4級，離岸5級，初時高地間中達7級。
周日大致天晴，晚上轉多雲，氣溫介乎22至28度。吹輕風2級，稍後轉東風3至4級。天文台較早時發出特別天氣提示，提醒市民留意最新天氣消息，進行戶外活動時注意天氣變化。
截至周六凌晨，天文台並無發出任何天氣警告，但預測顯示周六早段有狂風雷暴風險，其後天氣改善。
